connector.name: MCP Server Kalshi
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for end-to-end trading on Kalshi prediction markets: discover, research, trade.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-server-kalshi. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 9crusher account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KALSHI_API_KEY
env.description: Kalshi API key ID; required only for portfolio/order tools

env.name: KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
env.description: Path to your RSA private key .pem; required for authenticated tools

env.name: BASE_URL
env.description: Optional explicit REST base override (must include /trade-api/v2)
